title: hieracium umbrosum subsp. jaceoides
intro: Hieracium umbrosum subsp. jaceoides, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help in reducing pain and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which have been shown to possess analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Studies have also identified the presence of sesquiterpenes and flavonoids as the primary bioactive constituents responsible for the plant's therapeutic actions.
